tldr: 台股10月8日重挫492.93點收49,313.44點，連假前賣壓與美股走弱使5萬點漸行漸遠，三大法人賣超約899億元。
台積電9月營收5,118.57億元、年增54.6%創同期新高，推升第三季改寫單季紀錄，法說會訂10月15日登場。
金管會10月8日起開放銀行家族辦公室顧問業務走出高雄專區、全台落地，試辦專區受託資產已突破千億元。

items.title_zh: 台股連假前賣壓重挫493點收49,313點
items.title_en: TAIEX plunges 493 points to 49,313 on pre-holiday selling
items.summary_zh: 台股10月8日終場下跌492.93點、跌幅0.99%，收49,313.44點，成交值約8,696億元。雙十連假前投資人觀望，加上美股走弱拖累買氣，三大法人合計賣超898.95億元。本週指數一度逼近5萬點大關，但週四開低走低、賣壓湧現，顯示高檔套牢與獲利了結賣壓沉重，5萬點整數關卡壓力明顯，短線技術面轉弱。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX closed down 492.93 points (-0.99%) at 49,313.44 on Oct 8, on turnover of about NT$869.7 billion, as caution ahead of the Double Tenth holiday and a softer Wall Street weighed on sentiment. The three major institutional investors sold a net NT$89.9 billion. After flirting with the 50,000 milestone earlier in the week, the index opened lower and fell throughout the session, signalling resistance is building near record highs.

items.title_zh: 聯發科挫3%拖累IC設計、權值股走弱
items.title_en: MediaTek slides 3% and drags IC designers as weights soften
items.summary_zh: 權值股10月8日領跌：聯發科下跌約3%至4,690元、跌破月線，並拖累IC設計類股走弱；台積電尾盤爆出大量賣單、下跌35元收2,550元。龍頭股同步回檔壓抑大盤，反映投資人在雙十連假前降低持股、獲利了結，而非基本面轉壞。短線資金轉趨保守，待連假後與台積電法說會指引再定方向。
items.summary_en: Large-cap tech led the retreat on Oct 8. MediaTek fell about 3% to NT$4,690, breaking below its monthly average and pulling the broader IC-design sector lower, while TSMC shed NT$35 to NT$2,550 on heavy late selling. The weakness in heavyweight names capped the index and reflected investors trimming exposure ahead of the long weekend rather than fresh negative fundamentals.

items.title_zh: 台積電9月營收創同期新高，法說前市場聚焦
items.title_en: TSMC September sales set same-period record ahead of earnings call
items.summary_zh: 台積電公布9月合併營收5,118.57億元，年增54.6%、創歷年同期新高，僅較8月歷史高點微減0.6%。第三季營收1兆4,942億元，季增17.6%、年增51%，改寫單季紀錄；前三季累計約3.9兆元、年增41.1%。高效能運算與AI晶片需求強勁為主要動能，優於法人預期。市場聚焦10月15日法說會對AI需求與全年展望的最新看法。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported September consolidated revenue of NT$511.86 billion, up 54.6% year-on-year and a record for the month, though slightly below August's all-time high. Third-quarter revenue reached NT$1.4942 trillion, up 17.6% sequentially and 51% YoY for a record quarter, while nine-month revenue of about NT$3.9 trillion rose 41.1%. Strong HPC and AI chip demand drove the beat; management will give its outlook at the Oct 15 earnings call.

items.title_zh: 聯發科第三季營收超財測，資料中心AI ASIC Q4量產
items.title_en: MediaTek Q3 revenue beats guidance as data-center AI ASIC nears mass production
items.summary_zh: 聯發科9月營收553.99億元、月減約一成，但第三季營收1,680.57億元，超越自訂1,522億至1,598億元財測區間。公司表示首款資料中心AI加速器特殊應用晶片（ASIC）可望於第四季正式進入量產，為成長動能從手機與邊緣運算延伸至高毛利的AI基礎建設市場奠基，是其切入雲端AI商機的重要里程碑。
items.summary_en: MediaTek posted September revenue of NT$55.4 billion, down about 10% from August, but third-quarter revenue of NT$168.06 billion topped its own guidance range of NT$152.2–159.8 billion. The company said its first data-center AI accelerator ASIC is on track to enter volume production in the fourth quarter, a milestone that would diversify its growth beyond smartphones and edge chips into the high-margin AI infrastructure market.

items.title_zh: 金管會10月政策大爆發：高雄資產管理專區、虛擬資產專法接力上路
items.title_en: FSC's October policy push: Kaohsiung asset-management zone and virtual-asset law roll out
items.summary_zh: 金管會10月密集推動多項金融政策，包括深化高雄亞洲資產管理中心專區的誘因措施，以及虛擬資產服務（VASP）專法的分階段上路。整套政策旨在壯大台灣資本市場、吸引私人銀行與家族辦公室進駐，並將虛擬資產服務業者納入正式監理框架，是今年法規最密集的月份之一，牽動金融業務版圖與合規布局。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's FSC is advancing a cluster of financial-sector measures in October, including incentives for the Kaohsiung Asian Asset Management Center zone and the phased launch of a dedicated Virtual Asset Service (VASP) framework. The package aims to deepen Taiwan's capital markets, attract private banks and family offices, and bring crypto service providers under formal supervision, marking one of the busiest regulatory months of the year.

items.title_zh: 金管會擴大保險業設資安長範圍，7業者10月底前增設
items.title_en: FSC widens requirement for insurers to appoint chief information security officers
items.summary_zh: 金管會擴大要求保險業設置專責資訊安全長（資安長）的範圍，要求另外7家業者須於10月底前增設該職務。此舉強化保險業整體網路風險治理，因金融機構處理的敏感客戶資料量持續攀升；也反映主管機關在全球多起資安事件後，推動全業界提升資訊安全標準的政策方向，牽動業者的資安人力與系統投資。
items.summary_en: The FSC expanded the scope of insurers required to set up a dedicated chief information security officer, ordering seven more companies to add the role by the end of October. The move tightens cyber-risk governance across the insurance industry as financial firms handle growing volumes of sensitive customer data, and reflects regulators' push to raise information-security standards sector-wide after a string of global cyber incidents.

items.title_zh: 金管會開放銀行家族辦公室業務全台落地
items.title_en: FSC lets banks run family-office advisory services island-wide
items.summary_zh: 金管會10月8日訂定「銀行辦理家族辦公室顧問業務規範」並即日生效，讓家辦顧問業務走出高雄專區、全台開放。已辦理高資產業務且在專區試辦滿一年的11家銀行符合申請資格，且不分批、無申請期限。截至8月底，專區內17家銀行受託管理資產（AUM）已突破千億元、服務239名客戶，顯示高資產客群傳承與跨境資產配置需求強勁，國銀競逐私銀與家辦商機再添動能。
items.summary_en: The FSC on Oct 8 issued formal rules allowing banks to provide family-office advisory services beyond the Kaohsiung pilot zone, opening the business nationwide. Eleven banks that already run high-asset operations and have piloted the service for over a year qualify to apply, with no application deadline or batching. Within the pilot zone, 17 banks had amassed assets under advice exceeding NT$100 billion, serving 239 clients as of end-August—underscoring booming demand among the ultra-wealthy.

items.title_zh: 高資產財管市場衝向46兆元，國銀競逐財管執照
items.title_en: High-net-worth wealth market swells toward NT$46 trillion as banks race for licences
items.summary_zh: 台灣高資產財富管理市場持續快速擴張，KPMG安侯建業與玉山銀行調研估計，2026年資產逾1億元的高資產客戶將達12.4萬人、合計掌握約46.1兆元財富，2029年更將增至15.5萬人；逾七成客戶已布局境外資產。龐大商機帶動國銀競逐財管2.0執照，並積極建置私人銀行、家族辦公室與跨境資產管理平台，財管業務成為銀行獲利與差異化競爭的新藍海。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's high-asset wealth-management market continues to expand rapidly, with a KPMG–E.Sun study projecting the number of clients holding more than NT$100 million in assets will reach 124,000 in 2026, commanding roughly NT$46.1 trillion in wealth and rising to 155,000 by 2029. Over 70% already allocate to offshore assets. The growth is driving banks to compete for Wealth Management 2.0 licences and to build private-banking, family-office and cross-border platforms.
